forecasts.rationale: Binance ETHUSDT printed 2052.00 at 10:25 UTC on 2026-11-12 (https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=ETHUSDT&interval=1m&limit=3), about 2.3% under 2100, with daily closes sliding from 2497.95 to about 2056 over 30 days. With 30-day daily volatility of 2.56% and roughly 2.3 days left, 2100 is about 0.6 standard deviations away, so a thin-tailed model gives roughly 27-28%. Spot ETH ETF outflows (https://www.mitrade.com/insights/news/live-news/article-3-2239153-20261107) and the downtrend lean slightly bearish, while no scheduled macro event falls before resolution (https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm); coherent with the earlier 78% for above 2,000 on Nov 13.

Persistent spot BTC ETF outflows (https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/november-2026) and the downtrend from 83,169 on 2026-10-13 argue for fatter tails than the model, but no scheduled macro event falls before Nov 17.
